name: batondeck
description: Autonomous agent toolkit for BatonDeck (MCP-native Kanban): plan dependency trees, claim + work tasks with full context, heartbeat leases, hand off, and drain boards with worker fleets. Includes the batondeck-worker skill, /batondeck:work and /batondeck:plan commands, helper scripts, and the hosted BatonDeck MCP server (browser OAuth, no gcloud).
